Definition: Elkanah, the name of several Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elkanah = "God has possessed" or "God has created"; 1) Samuel's father; 2) a ruler in Jerusalem in the time of king Ahaz; 3) one of David's mighty warriors; 4) son of Korah; 5) several Levites
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
